trigger.issue: The first exact-code chick/extinction join was dominated by a single CHR 2003 risk set with a Pearson contrast >100.
trigger.diagnosis: For the event colony CHR 7.1 in season 2003, the frozen November adult census reports 2 breeding pairs whereas the January chick table Adults field reports 277, so exact colony_code equality is not sufficient evidence that the two tables refer to the same breeding-group unit in every season.
trigger.interpretation: The unrepaired primary chick result is provenance-invalid for ecological inference rather than evidence of enhanced pre-extinction reproduction.

coherence_gate.comparison: For each exact island + colony_code + season match, compare the frozen November breeding-pair count N with the chick-table Adults field A.
coherence_gate.role: This is an identifier/provenance gate only. The Adults field is not used as the reproductive-performance denominator or outcome.
coherence_gate.rationale: A more-than-twofold magnitude disagreement within the same breeding season is treated as insufficient evidence that identical colony_code labels identify the same breeding-group unit across the two source tables.

duplicate_handling.identical_chick_duplicates: If chick counts are identical and exactly one duplicate row has Adults > 0, retain that positive-Adults record for the coherence gate.
duplicate_handling.multiple_positive_adult_values: Exclude unless both Adults and Chicks are identical.

repaired_test.risk_sets: Start from the frozen parent durable-extinction risk sets; retain only joined colony-season rows passing the coherence gate.
repaired_test.minimum: At least 5 informative risk sets with at least one event and one non-event after gating, otherwise declare insufficient coverage.
repaired_test.null: Exactly the frozen within-island-season proportional Multinomial chick-allocation null from PALMER_PREEXTINCTION_CHICK_PERFORMANCE_V1.
repaired_test.statistic: Exactly the frozen event-minus-non-event Pearson reproductive-performance residual contrast, equal weighted across informative risk sets.

threshold_sensitivities.rule: Report both regardless of direction; do not select a threshold by significance.

decision.exploratory_signal: At the frozen 2x gate, observed contrast < 0 and p <= 0.05, with negative observed contrasts at both 1.5x and 3x gates.
decision.no_signal: Otherwise do not claim a pre-extinction reproductive penalty.
decision.status: Even if supported, this is a post-primary provenance-repaired exploratory result, not an independent confirmatory result.

boundaries: Do not interpret excluded rows as biologically anomalous; they are identifier-incoherent for this cross-table analysis.
Do not further tune the magnitude threshold after repaired outcomes are opened.
Do not infer recruitment causality, Allee effects, snow, predation or food mechanisms from the repaired chick test alone.
The unrepaired exact-code result must remain documented as a failed provenance gate.
